notes.zh-CN: 修复图片预览缩放：放大后不再常驻滚动条，改为按住图片拖动平移；滚轮缩放时保持画面中心，不再跳到左上角。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fixes image preview zooming: enlarged pictures no longer show scrollbars and are panned by dragging instead; wheel zoom now keeps the centre of the view instead of jumping to the top-left corner. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
